summary: Your admins' tiers stay current, and one slow report never holds up a run.

new.title: Tiers come from a current daily catalog
new.text: Every installation now downloads the daily classified catalog of roles and permissions, checked before it is used. If a download fails, the last good one is kept.

new.title: Tier classification never holds up a night
new.text: If the catalog cannot be read or built, the night goes on with the last known classification and says so.

new.title: Break-glass accounts are always Tier 0
new.text: A break-glass account is always Tier 0, whatever roles it holds right now.

new.title: Built-in roles follow your classification
new.text: With AI integration on, built-in roles follow your own classification instead of the shipped list.

fixes.title: One slow report no longer holds a run
fixes.text: When Microsoft keeps timing out on one heavy report, its retries now get a time limit of 90 minutes, a setting. Parts not read are reported as unknown, never as resolved, and the run goes on.

fixes.title: The data health check always reports
fixes.text: When its last report is more than a day old and the installation is idle, the data health check now runs on its own.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The size jump warning appears only on a real jump in a report's size. An old collection job from before the collection was split is removed after 14 days.
